title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product (Hybrid)
description:
Location: London, UK - Hybrid (2 days per week in office)

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job
OpenTable is looking for a highly motivated, practical, and business-oriented Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product to join our Legal team. You will serve as a trusted advisor to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing strategic and practical counsel across product development, privacy and data protection, artificial intelligence, information security, consumer protection, and related regulatory matters. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.

• Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.

• Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.

• Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.

• Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing. 

• Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.

• Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, and product matters, preferably in-house at a technology, consumer, marketplace, or other high-growth company.

title: Firmware Engineer I
locationText: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace and empowering every employee to do their best work.

Your Impact

As a Firmware Engineer I on the Platform Firmware team, you will join our Board Support Package (BSP) development efforts for current and next-generation Axon devices. You will work close to the hardware, developing and integrating the low-level software that enables new platforms and peripherals - from board bring-up and device drivers to system services, hardware interfaces, and platform validation. You will work with Firmware, Electrical Engineering, Product, Software, Manufacturing, and other embedded teams to deliver reliable device software.

Our firmware environments primarily use Embedded Linux on SoCs/SoMs, with Embedded Android and RTOS-based microcontrollers used across some product lines. Depending on the program, you may work with C, C++, Rust, Golang, or Python.

As a Firmware Engineer I,  you are a focused problem solver. You break down and solve tasks end-to-end within a feature, build familiarity with the technology stack and foundational domain knowledge, and operate with regular oversight and guidance from the tech lead and more senior engineers on the team. Over time you begin to understand how your work connects to product and customer outcomes.

Where You’ll Work

Work Location: This role is based out of our Ho Chi Minh Office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Travel: Firmware engineering requires hands-on collaboration with Hardware Engineering. Travel to manufacturing locations may be required during board bring-up, hardware validation, manufacturing support, and other critical product milestones.

What You’ll Do

Reports to: Engineering Manager, Platform Firmware
Direct Reports: None

• Design, develop, test, and maintain firmware for current and next-generation Axon devices.

• Develop firmware for Embedded Linux or Embedded Android on SoCs and SoMs.

• Develop software for microcontrollers and RTOS-based systems where required.

• Work with device peripherals and connectivity technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, Sub-GHz, and cellular .

• Develop firmware for battery, power, and thermal-management subsystems with a strong focus on reliability and safety.

• Support board bring-up, hardware integration, and debugging in partnership with Electrical Engineering.

• Develop unit, integration, and automated tests and contribute to test infrastructure and engineering excellence.

• Develop manufacturing

title: Senior Regulatory and Securities Attorney
description:
Flow Traders is seeking an experienced Senior Regulatory & Securities Attorney to serve as senior in-house legal advisor on U.S. securities law across its ETF, cash equity, digital-asset, and tokenization businesses.

This role will provide legal guidance to trading, business, and operations teams; supports  transactional and regulatory legal work; advise on regulatory developments and new business initiatives; and help manage legal risk in a complex, fast-paced, and internationally integrated new environment.

The candidate will work closely with Compliance, Risk, and Business Development, while operating as an integrated member of Flow Traders’ global Legal team. The role will have a  meaningful focus on digital assets, tokenization, market structure, and the application of securities laws to emerging financial products and infrastructure.

What you will do

• Serve as lead in-house resource on U.S. securities law, including the Securities Act of 1933, Exchange Act of 1934, Investment Advisers Act, and applicable FINRA/SEC rules.

• Advise business, trading, and operations teams on broker-dealer regulatory requirements, trading practices, and new product development.

• Provide legal guidance on digital asset classification, tokenized securities, and application of securities frameworks to blockchain-based products.

• Monitor SEC, FINRA, CFTC, and FinCEN developments; interpret and communicate implications to internal stakeholders.

• Advise on structuring and launch of new business lines, products, and geographic expansion.

• Identify legal and regulatory risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.

• Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including trading, vendor, technology, and partnership agreements.

• Provide legal support for strategic transactions, including investments, joint ventures, and acquisitions involving digital-asset businesses or infrastructure.

• Develop and maintain standard-form agreements, legal playbooks, And knowledge-sharing resources.

• Collaborate with Global Legal team to promote consistent processes and legal standards across jurisdictions.

• Manage relationships with outside counsel, including matter scoping, work allocation, and legal spend.

• Work alongside existing Legal Counsel and other members of the legal team, providing substantive input, collaboration, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing.

What you need to succeed

• Required

• J.D. from an accredited law school; active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar (New York strongly preferred).

• 6 + years of relevant legal experience, with a preference for candidates whose experience reflects substantial hands-on responsibility in a complex, fast-paced regulatory environment.

• Significant experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house at a financial services firm, broker-dealer, trading firm, or regulatory agency (SEC, FINRA, CFTC).

• Deep expertise in U.S. federal securities law, including SEC and FINRA rules applicable to broker-dealers.

• Experience advising on digital assets, cryptocurrency, or blockchain-related legal matters, including token classification, DeFi, and application of securities laws to digital-asset products.

• Strong understanding of trading and market structure, including equity, fixed income, and/or ETP markets.

• Excellent written/verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complex legal issues for non-legal audiences.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills, sound organizational judgment, and sensitivity to organizational dynamics.

• A proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented communication style.

• Preferred

• Experience at or advising a proprietary trading firm, market maker, or exchange.

• Familiarity with AML/BSA requirements as applied to broker-dealers and digital-asset businesses.

• Experience with cross-border securities law issues and international regulatory frameworks.

• Exposure to investment adviser regulations,

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Infra/Ops - Fraud
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Data team within Plaid’s Fraud organization builds the machine learning systems that power Plaid’s fraud detection products, leveraging Plaid’s unique network data to identify and stop fraud before it happens. The team owns the full ML lifecycle-from feature pipelines and model training to production serving and monitoring-building reliable, scalable systems that deliver high-quality fraud detection as we grow to support hundreds of customers.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will own the development of high-performance feature computation and online inference pipelines that power production machine learning systems at scale. You’ll build robust observability, monitoring, and automated debugging capabilities, while leveraging AI-assisted tools to investigate complex system behavior and maintain high reliability. You’ll partner closely with ML Infrastructure, Data Science, and Product teams to execute critical technical initiatives and deliver scalable, high-impact ML solutions.

Responsibilities:

- Build and scale machine learning systems that power a rapidly growing fraud detection product in a fast-paced environment.

- Solve complex technical challenges at the intersection of machine learning, data infrastructure, and production reliability.

- Develop foundational ML capabilities that leverage Plaid’s extensive financial network data to detect and prevent fraud.

- Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional partners across Plaid to deliver high-impact solutions.

Qualifications:

- 6+ years of relevant experience, with a strong focus on building, deploying, and scaling production machine learning systems.

- Strong experience with ML infrastructure and operations, including production deployment, monitoring, and reliability.

- Proven ability to independently own and deliver complex, end-to-end machine learning engineering projects.

- Proficiency with Python and experience with ML and data technologies such as PyTorch, Spark, SageMaker, and Airflow.

Nice-to-Have:

- Experience in fraud or risk domains.

- Experience in Graph machine learning.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

title: Senior Manager – Payments (She/ He/ They)
description:
CAPCO POLAND 

*We are looking for Poland based candidate. 
This role is hybrid.

At Capco Poland, we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Help financial institutions navigate the evolving payments landscape and turn market, regulatory and technology change into practical business outcomes.

The Role

As a Senior Manager specializing in Payments at Capco, you will advise banks and other financial institutions on complex payments challenges, helping clients respond to changing customer expectations, regulatory requirements and developments across the payments ecosystem.

You will work closely with senior client stakeholders across Payments, Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance, supporting engagements spanning payments strategy, operating model transformation, regulatory change and the modernization of payments capabilities.

This is a senior advisory role combining deep payments knowledge, consulting expertise and strong stakeholder management. You will help clients assess opportunities and challenges, define target-state solutions and deliver sustainable change while contributing to the continued development of Capco’s Payments offering in Poland.

What You’ll Do

• Advise banks and other financial institutions on payments strategy, transformation and regulatory change, translating complex market and regulatory developments into practical business actions.

• Lead advisory and transformation engagements across the payment’s lifecycle, including payment products, processes, operating models and supporting capabilities.

• Support clients in responding to developments across the European and Polish payments landscape, assessing business impacts and defining effective implementation and transformation roadmaps.

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Payments, Product, Operations, Technology, Risk and Compliance, providing clear advice and supporting effective decision-making.

• Lead client engagements and contribute to the growth of Capco’s Payments offering through proposition development, client conversations and the identification of new advisory opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

• Significant experience in payments within financial services, gained within consulting, banking, payments or a combination of these environments.

• Strong knowledge of the Polish and European payments landscape, including payment products, infrastructure, market developments and the regulatory environment.

• Knowledge of European payments regulation and industry developments, including PSD2/PSD3, the Payment Services Regulation (PSR) and instant payments.

• Experience across areas such as SEPA, SWIFT, payment schemes, cards, account-to-account payments, open banking or cross-border payments.

• Experience supporting payments modernization, payment platform transformation or operating model change within a bank or payment services organization.

• Practical experience delivering payments strategy, transformation, regulatory change or operating model initiatives within banks or other financial institutions.

• Strong advisory and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to communicate complex payments topics clearly to senior management and work effectively across business and technology functions.

• Experience leading consulting engagements or complex payments initiatives, including managing teams, senior stakeholders, delivery priorities and client outcomes.

Bonus Points For

• Previous consulting experience with Tier 1 banks or other major financial institutions.

• Experience developing payments propositions, supporting business development or contributing to client proposals and senior-level client discussions.

title: Solutions Architect - Lakebase
description:
The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritised product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region.  Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product.  They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

 

The Lakebase product-line requires the following core technical competencies:

• 10+ years of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing solutions.

title: Director of Managed Care Pharmacy Analytics
description:
The Director of Managed Care Pharmacy Analytics leads two core components of our pharmacy product. First, in an externally facing, subject-matter-expert capacity, this role serves as the pharmacist voice on client calls, discussing payment integrity findings, creating and telling the story with analytics, and potentially acting as the clinical lead representing clients through PBM RFPs. Second, the this role acts as the clinical subject-matter expert on model development, ensuring payment integrity models make clinical and operational sense. Across both, this role brings enough command of PBM operations and analytics to drive realistic, actionable recommendations, partners closely with the data science team, and speaks to findings independently with clients and PBMs. This Position also collaborates with cross-functional teams, including product, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Client PBM Guidance:

• Serve as the primary pharmacy/clinical subject-matter expert on client calls, discussing payment integrity findings and translating analytics into clear, actionable stories for clients.

• Potentially act as the clinical lead for PBM RFP evaluations and collaborating with the analytics team to ensure contract and financial guarantee findings are clinically and contractually sound.

Clinical Model Development & Payment Integrity:

• Partner with the data science team to shape and validate the clinical logic behind pharmacy models and AI/algorithm development, including formulary and utilization management rules, drug classification, specialty/LDD designations, and payment integrity trend and anomaly detection.

• Ensure payment integrity findings are integrated into the broader PBM strategy and client-narrative, rather than treated as a standalone deliverable.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership:

• Contribute to the strategic direction of the pharmacy offering, with a focus on improving client PBM knowledge, payment integrity, and analytics outcomes.

• Work closely with leadership to shape the vision and goals for pharmacy-related strategy, PBM operations, and payment integrity initiatives.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data science, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Regulatory Compliance and Industry Standards:

• Stay current on evolving healthcare regulations, pharmacy industry standards, and payer requirements.

• Ensure PBM strategy and payment integrity work align with government regulations (e.g., CMS, CAA) and payer contract requirements.

Qualifications:

• Education:

• PharmD, with a Managed Care Residency preferred

• Training in analytic methods and/or pharmacy data analysis recommended

• Experience:

• Minimum 6-8 years of experience in pharmacy benefit management, with meaningful client-facing or PBM-facing experience.

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in analyzing pharmacy claims data, especially payment integrity issues.

• Demonstrated understanding of how PBM operations work in practice, e.g., how claims adjudicate, how pricing/rebate terms are administered, and where contract terms and real-world operations diverge. This is often gained through roles such as trade/rebate contract negotiation, account management, clinical data science/analytics, or PBM clinical/claims operations.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret PBM contract terms (pricing guarantees, rebate arrangements, definitions) and connect them to clinical and financial impact.

• Comfortable partnering closely with an analytics team and speaking independently

The Senior Content Specialist is the experienced professional responsible for reviewing flagged and reported content, making final enforcement decisions within an established policy framework, and owning the customer conversation when those decisions are appealed. Automated systems catch a large share of policy violations, but this role exists to catch what the system gets wrong, and to hold the line where it's right. This is a journey-level Trust & Safety position requiring independent judgment, sound written communication, and comfort operating with real autonomy on complex, sensitive cases.
WHY DO WE WANT YOU

title: AI Cinematographer - LA
description:
Noë & Associates is a global brand consultancy working across real estate, hospitality, and luxury. We specialise in the unbuilt - creating brands and telling the stories of places before they exist. From our studios in New York, London, and Dubai, we have helped bring billions of dollars of developments to market for clients including Aman, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental, Jumeirah, and IHG. We are hiring an AI Cinematographer to help us picture the unbuilt: cinematic film and motion, made with the new generation of generative video tools, for some of the world’s most ambitious luxury developments and destinations. We are proud to be part of Together Group , a curated collective of high-quality creative consultancies, marketing, technology and production studios. Together, we create and elevate brands, experiences and destinations of the future.

This role is initially offered on a contract basis, with the potential to become permanent.

Key Responsibilities

The role

This is a craft role at the frontier. You trained in film and you think like a cinematographer - in composition, lens, light, movement, and pace - and you have carried that language into AI video, where the tools now let us show a place, a feeling, and a way of living long before anything is built. You will work alongside our strategists, designers, editors, and producers to develop the look and feel of residences, resorts, and destinations still in design - turning a vision into something a client and their audience can actually see and feel.

What you’ll do

• Create cinematic film and motion with generative video tools - from early concept films to finished campaign work. • Work primarily in Kling, our current tool of choice, with room to use Seedance and other tools where they serve the work better. • Translate real cinematographic craft - framing, lensing, lighting, camera movement, edit rhythm - into prompts, references, and generative workflows that hold a high bar for taste and finish. • Develop looks and visual worlds for the unbuilt: places that do not yet exist, made convincing and beautiful on screen. • Exercise judgement about tools - which model or approach serves a given shot, and when a result is genuinely good enough to ship. • Stay at the edge of a fast-moving field and bring back what is worth using.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• A real grounding in film. Film school or equivalent training, with genuine command of cinematic language, pacing, and storytelling - film specifically, not photography. You think in motion, and you know how a single shot lives within a sequence. • Fluency with AI video generation. Hands-on experience with Kling especially; Seedance and/or other generative tools are valued, along with the judgement to know which suits the shot. • An eye for the high end. Taste, precision, and restraint suited to luxury brands - with a feel for architecture and the spaces our work brings to life. • Self-direction. Clear communication and the discipline to own work across time zones.

We are open on level. The role suits a recent film graduate fluent in today’s tools, but we are glad to talk to stronger candidates.

title: Fashion Design to UX Design Career Changer

About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

title: Head of AI Native Operations
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Head of AI Operations to own how Supabase works.

Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system: a common way of working across the company where AI carries a meaningful share of the operational load rather than sitting alongside it as an assistant. We are standing up a new central team to build those systems, enable the teams, and embed AI operations throughout the organization. This is the role that runs it.

You will own the maturity model teams are assessed against, the standards that define how work happens here, and the operating cadence, under one design rule: every recurring meeting has to justify why an automated report cannot replace it. You will lead a small team of senior individual contributors, one building the platform and one running enablement.

The premise is that process encoded as agents scales where process enforced by people does not. Your job is to prove that is a repeatable pattern rather than an anomaly, across teams you have no authority over.

We are fully remote and async. The document is the enforcement mechanism here, which means the standards themselves are your deliverable.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you'll:

- Own the maturity model end to end: The rubric, the scoring method, the evidence standard, and the appeals path. Every team ends up with a published assessment and a written plan to its next level.

- Run assessments and commitments: Conduct assessments with department heads yourself, landing them as commitments with named owners and dates rather than opinions.

- Own the standards layer: Define how work gets tracked, decisions get proposed and resolved, teams migrate onto shared tooling, and stale documentation gets retired. Standards ship as documents teams follow without being chased.

- Fix the decision process: Ensure written proposals reach resolution instead of accumulating unresolved by defining stages, exit criteria, and closing mechanisms.

- Run the operating cadence: Lead automated weekly reporting, a regular blockers-and-decisions forum, a monthly leadership review, and a quarterly board-level format. Delete meetings a report could replace.

- Manage rollouts: Execute private assessments first so leads see only their own and have time to move, followed by a pre-committed public transparency date.

- Wire standards into onboarding: Ensure every cohort arrives pre-trained rather than inheriting nearby habits.

- Build and direct the team: Hire, grow, review, and direct two senior individual contributors (platform and enablement) without doing their work for them.

- Measure and publish outcomes: Measure and publish whether the thesis holds by tracking how much coordination work agents absorb versus what a human program office would cost.

HOW YOU'LL THINK

RECURSIVE THINKING

Every standard you write should be the input to something that enforces it, and every enforcement mechanism should produce the evidence that grades it. When you write the rule that work must carry a current status, you are not finished until a report finds the stale items and tells their owners without you in the loop. The same applies to your own function: the team you build gets assessed by the model you own, published next to everyone else's, and you should want that.

INVERSION THINKING

The default outcome for a company-wide standard is that teams politely ignore it. So the first question about any standard is not "is this correct" but "what will make people route around this," and the design follows from that answer. title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
About xCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.

We are building for the lives people want to live.

Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:

xCures is hiring an AI Solutions Engineer to join a team that sits between our customers and our platform. This is a software engineering role: you will write and own production code, not run demos from a script. You will report to the Director, Customer Solutions, with a dotted line to Engineering. Half your time goes to customer-facing work: the integrations, connectors, and proofs of concept that take diagnostic labs and health systems from signed contract to live data faster. The other half goes to the tools the company runs on: the agents, skills, and automations that let a small team operate like a much larger one.

You will write code that ships to customers within weeks, see how it changes their workflow, and help shape how the Customer Solutions team builds and ships software. The work spans integrations, agents, and prototypes, and the problems rarely arrive well defined, so range and comfort with ambiguity matter as much as depth. You will work directly with customers and turn their requirements into working software. xCures is operationalizing AI across the whole company, so the AI-native way of working here is the default, not an experiment. If you want to build at the intersection of AI and healthcare interoperability with real customers and real production stakes, this is that job.

Key Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain customer integrations, including data connectors, API-based integrations, and FHIR and C-CDA data flows, and own them from first commit through production

• Build and ship agents, skills, and automations that Customer Solutions, Customer Success, and Sales use in their daily work

• Prototype proofs of concept and demo environments for prospects using synthetic patient records only, and carry each POC end to end with the account team

• Support customer onboarding and technical troubleshooting, resolving issues at the Customer Solutions layer so fewer escalate to Engineering

• Join discovery calls with Sales and Channel Partnerships to ask the technical questions that qualify a deal, answer technical questions throughout the sales cycle, and contribute to RFP responses and security questionnaires

• Work with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Sales and Channel Partnerships to scope integrations, surface product gaps, and hand off cleanly when work belongs in the core platform

• Follow the team's SDLC: every session starts with a ticket, work moves through code review and CI/CD, and shipped work is documented

• Build with security first: threat-model what you ship, pro

description:
About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We are a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading meal kit provider. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions: HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

About the role: What's in the Box

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our global Consumer Experience team, working in either Growth or Consumer . This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role in an AI-native design environment. You'll own a problem space, influence what we build and why, and raise the standard of the designers around you.

Your focus area is confirmed during the process:

• Growth: acquisition, conversion, checkout, payment, reactivation, and new purchase models.

• Consumer: onboarding, subscription management, loyalty and rewards, referrals, discovery, cooking, and engagement.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Own critical customer journeys end to end, from problem framing to a shipped, measured outcome.

• Turn complex customer and business problems into simple experiences that communicate value clearly, reduce friction and build trust.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, CRM, and other UX practitioners to shape product direction, balancing near-term impact with long-term customer trust and value.

• Build reusable patterns that hold across meal kits and ready-to-heat.

• Use AI throughout your practice, from synthesis and discovery to rapid prototyping and design-to-code, with tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, and Figma Make, and explore AI-native customer experiences.

• Build alignment through evidence and clear rationale and raise the bar on your squad through critique and shared practice.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

• Typically 4-6+ years of product design experience, though we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.

• End-to-end ownership of complex experiences, ideally in e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, or loyalty, with outcomes: what moved, by how much, and what you did when a result came back wrong.

• Exceptional interface craft: interaction and visual design, information architecture, motion, and micro-interactions. Your portfolio shows judgment (what you decided and why), not just polish.

• Experimentation fluency: you turn data and customer insight into design bets without trading away trust and customer value.

• AI in your daily workflow. You give it the context and intent it needs, and you audit what comes back. Curiosity and appetite for working in code and AI-native tools.

• Ownership: when the copy is wrong you fix it, and nothing falls between job descriptions.

• Comfort with ambiguity and clear communication across Product, Engineering, Data, and your fellow UX practitioners.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. If you meet most of these requirements and are excited about the role, we'd love to hear from you. Above all, we want people who will make HelloFresh better.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Anchorage, AK, USA
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: HiL V&V Manager
description:
What you will do:

As the HiL Test Manager, you will lead a team of HiL test engineers responsible for the hardware-in-the-loop verification and validation (V&V) of Torc’s autonomous truck. You will own the HiL test strategy and set the technical direction for the team, ensuring that HiL test evidence supports Torc’s safety case and aligns with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and ISO 21448 (SOTIF). You will also partner with development, integration, systems, and safety teams and be instrumental in growing the robustness and safety of our self-driving technology.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of HiL test engineers, setting clear goals, priorities, and development plans.

• Define and own the HiL test strategy, roadmap, and technical direction in support of Torc’s autonomous truck safety case.

• Ensure HiL test methods, processes, and evidence align with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF), including verification of safety mechanisms and fault handling, and testing of triggering conditions and performance limitations.

• Partner with Product, Systems, and Safety teams to translate functional and safety requirements into HiL test specifications.

• Plan and oversee HiL test campaigns, including resourcing, scheduling, bench allocation, and delivery against program milestones.

• Guide the design of in-house HiL benches to achieve the HiL test strategy.

• Ensure test cases, procedures, and results are documented with traceability to requirements; identify testing gaps and manage relationships with internal tools teams and external HiL vendors.

• Review HiL results, drive defect triage, and communicate V&V status, risks, and findings to engineering leadership and stakeholders through dashboards and test reports.

What you’ll need to succeed:

A Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field with 6+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with 4+ years of experience.

• Significant experience (typically 6+ years) driving HiL V&V on complex engineering systems, including defining test plans, executing campaigns, and reporting results.

• Working knowledge of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and how they apply to HiL-based verification and validation.

• Experience defining HiL test strategy and overseeing the development of test cases with traceability to functional and safety requirements.

• Understanding of Autonomous Driving technologies, including sensors (LiDAR, radar, cameras), perception, sensor fusion, and vehicle dynamics.

• Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2 (topics, services, actions) system monitoring and diagnostics.

• Knowledge of CAN bus protocols and tools such as Vector CANoe and CANalyzer.

• Proficiency in Python, CAPL and/or C++ and Git, with the ability to guide the development of HiL test scripts and automation frameworks.

• Experience with system-level troubleshooting, fault isolation, and root-cause analysis across integrated hardware and software.

• Experience managing cross-functional partners and external vendors, and effectively communicating progress and test results to leadership and stakeholders.

Bonus Points!
Experience contributing to safety cases or safety assurance arguments, including HiL tool and bench qualification (e.g., ISO 26262 tool confidence).

• Experience with fault injection testing and verification of safety mechanisms on embedded and ECU-level systems.

• ADAS or autonomous vehicle verification and validation experience.

• Experience correlating HiL results with simulation and track or road testing.

• Experience hiring, building, and scaling engineering teams.
